name: meal
description: Rezepte finden, Nährwerte berechnen und Gerichte an deine Ernährung anpassen, mit einer Ersatz-Wissensbasis, die aus deinen Entscheidungen lernt.
long_description:
**Meal MCP** macht aus Claude einen Küchenassistenten mit Gedächtnis: Rezepte finden, Nährwerte berechnen und Gerichte an deine Ernährung anpassen.

**Was du damit machen kannst**

- **Rezepte** aus TheMealDB suchen und lokal speichern, mit Fotos als Dateien
- **Nährwerte** mit USDA-Daten berechnen, auch ohne gespeichertes Rezept und mit deutschen Zutatennamen
- **Zutaten ersetzen**: Claude schlägt vor, du entscheidest; freigegebene Regeln werden wiederverwendet, abgelehnte Vorschläge kommen nicht wieder
- **Varianten** speichern, zum Beispiel vegan oder ohne Nüsse, mit angepassten Mengen und umgeschriebener Anleitung
- **Vergleichen**: Original und Variante nebeneinander, Zutat für Zutat
- **Korrigieren**: falsche USDA-Treffer sperren oder Werte vom Etikett eintragen
- **Portionen**: Nährwerte pro Portion und Mengen für eine andere Personenzahl
- **Sichern**: alles als Datei exportieren und wieder einlesen

**So probierst du es aus**

- „Suche Chicken Handi, speichere es und berechne die Nährwerte.“
- „Mach das Rezept vegan und speichere die Variante.“
- „Vergleiche die Nährwerte der Variante mit dem Original.“

**Du brauchst** einen eigenen, kostenlosen USDA-API-Key (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup). Claude Desktop fragt bei der Installation danach.

**Gut zu wissen:** Rezepte, Regeln und Varianten liegen in einer lokalen Datenbank auf deinem Rechner. Sie liegt außerhalb der Erweiterung und übersteht eine Neuinstallation. Suchanfragen gehen an TheMealDB und USDA, Tool-Ergebnisse wie jeder Chatinhalt an Claude. Nährwerte sind Schätzungen. Tags wie „nussfrei“ ersetzen nicht den Blick aufs Etikett, und bei Allergien ist das keine verlässliche Grundlage.

usda_api_key.title: USDA API key
usda_api_key.description: Dein eigener, kostenloser Key für USDA FoodData Central: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup

tools.name: adapt_recipes
tools.description:
Adapt several saved recipes using the substitution knowledge base.

Substitute amounts follow the quantity_ratio of each substitution: mass and volume are scaled,
piece counts are converted to grams with USDA portion weights (run enrich_recipes first).
Amounts that cannot be converted are listed in unverified_quantities.
hidden_ingredients lists known ingredients that stand only in a measure text or the instructions and
were not replaced: tell the user. Above 5 recipes the result is compact (no instructions, short
ingredient rows); save_adapted_recipes accepts it. compact=false forces full detail.
The result is not stored. To keep a variant, pass items of adapted_recipes to save_adapted_recipes.

tools.name: add_substitutions
tools.description:
Add several ingredient substitutions to the local knowledge base, or change their quantity rule.

Optional per item: quantity_ratio (grams of target per gram of source, default 1.0) and
quantity_note (e.g. "1 egg = 1 tbsp ground flaxseed + 3 tbsp water"). For an existing pair they
replace the stored rule (listed in updated); adapt_recipes uses the ratio for substitute amounts.

tools.name: approve_substitutions
tools.description:
Approve pending suggestions and activate them in the knowledge base.

Each item: {"id": <suggestion id>} or source_ingredient/target_ingredient, plus an optional
"feedback" with the user's own words. Calling it again for an already approved suggestion with
"feedback" adds the comment later.

tools.name: calculate_nutrition
tools.description:
Calculate nutrition of free ingredients without a saved recipe: [{name, measure}], e.g.
[{"name": "Hähnchen", "measure": "500 g"}, {"name": "Zwiebeln", "measure": "2"}].

Uses the same USDA matching, portion weights and manual rules as recipes. Common German names
are translated; English names match more reliably. Check usda_match in ingredient_breakdown and
fix wrong matches with set_ingredient_matches. With servings the result also contains per_serving.

tools.name: compare_nutrition
tools.description:
Compare the nutrition of recipe variants with their originals.

Pass variant IDs, or an original ID to compare all its variants. Returns calories, protein,
fat and carbs of both, the absolute and percent difference, the coverage (how many ingredients
are counted) and the effect of each ingredient change. enrich=true loads missing USDA data first.
If a replaced ingredient has no data, comparable is false and difference is null: do not present
partial_difference as a result; notes names the cause. Above 5 comparisons the result is compact
(only uncounted change_effects, no uncovered_ingredients); compact=false forces full detail.

tools.name: delete_recipes
tools.description: Delete several locally saved recipes or variants. Deleting an original also deletes its variants.

tools.name: delete_substitutions
tools.description: Delete several substitutions identified by source and target ingredient.

tools.name: download_recipe_images
tools.description:
Save the photos of several saved recipes or variants as JPEG files, e.g. for a recipe book.

size: small (150 px, about 10 KB), medium (350 px, about 35 KB), large (500 px) or original
(about 700 px). Without folder the files go
to the images folder in the data folder; the result lists one path per recipe. Variants get the
photo of their original. Files already there are not downloaded again.

tools.name: enrich_recipes
tools.description:
Enrich several saved recipes with cached USDA nutrition data in one tool call.

Set refresh=true to look up all ingredients again and replace cached USDA matches; use it with a few
recipes at a time. Long runs stop in time and save their progress: if complete is false, call again
with the same IDs.

tools.name: export_data
tools.description:
Save all recipes, variants, substitutions, decisions, USDA matches and label values to a JSON file.

Without path the file goes to the exports folder in the data folder; the result names the location.
An existing file is not overwritten. The file holds no API key.

tools.name: find_substitutions
tools.description: Find suitable substitutions for several ingredients in one call.

tools.name: get_nutrition
tools.description:
Return estimated nutrition summaries for several saved recipes.

Call enrich_recipes first: ingredients without USDA data are not counted.
ingredient_breakdown lists the USDA food used for each ingredient and how its grams were derived
(grams_basis: measured, USDA portion weight for pieces and spoons, or approx. 1 g/ml for volumes).
per_serving is null until the servings are known (set_recipe_servings).
Above 5 recipes the result is compact (totals, coverage, uncovered ingredients); compact=false forces
full detail, compact=true forces the short form.

tools.name: get_recipes
tools.description:
Return several saved recipes or variants in full: ingredients, instructions and, for variants,
the original recipe, constraints and changes.

tools.name: import_data
tools.description:
Load a file written by export_data into the database.

Adds what is missing and keeps everything that already exists, so nothing is overwritten and
importing twice changes nothing. If the file is damaged, nothing is imported.

tools.name: list_ingredient_matches
tools.description:
List USDA matches of ingredients with their source (auto or manual), rejected foods and notes.

Without ingredients, lists all cached matches and rules.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description:
List all locally saved recipes and variants (is_variant, parent_mealdb_id, variant_ids;
variants also constraints and change_count). Use get_recipes for details.

tools.name: list_substitution_suggestions
list_substitutions
tools.description: List all substitutions in the local knowledge base.

tools.name: record_substitution_suggestions
tools.description:
Validate and store candidate substitutions as pending suggestions.

Each suggestion needs source_ingredient, target_ingredient, reason, confidence and tags.
Candidates violating the constraints or previously rejected under the same constraints are
returned in excluded_candidates. Pending suggestions are decided with approve_substitutions
or reject_substitutions.

tools.name: reject_ingredient_matches
tools.description:
Reject wrong USDA matches: [{ingredient, fdc_id (default: current match), note}].

The rejected food is never chosen again for that ingredient; the next best match is loaded
and returned in new_matches.

tools.name: reject_substitutions
tools.description:
Reject pending suggestions and record the decision.

Each item: {"id": <suggestion id>} or source_ingredient/target_ingredient, plus "feedback"
with the user's reason for the rejection (e.g. "mag ich nicht"). Calling it again for an
already rejected suggestion with "feedback" adds the reason later.

tools.name: rewrite_instructions
tools.description:
Prepare rewriting the instructions of several saved recipe variants.

Returns one request per variant with the current instructions, the ingredient changes, the
replaced terms and guidelines. Write the new instructions yourself following the guidelines,
then call save_rewritten_instructions. Variants already rewritten are skipped unless force=true.

tools.name: save_adapted_recipes
tools.description:
Save several adapted recipes as variants with their own IDs. The originals stay unchanged.

Pass the items of adapted_recipes from adapt_recipes, optionally edited. Each item needs
source_mealdb_id and ingredients ([{position, name, measure}]); name, instructions, constraints
and changes are optional. The server computes the differences to the original. Saving the same
variant twice returns the existing one. Variant IDs look like "52795-v1" and work with
get_recipes, enrich_recipes, get_nutrition and delete_recipes.

tools.name: save_recipes
tools.description: Load and save several TheMealDB recipes, including ingredients.

tools.name: save_rewritten_instructions
tools.description:
Store rewritten instructions for several variants: [{mealdb_id, instructions}].

The text is marked as LLM-generated (instructions_source='llm'). Warnings list replaced
ingredients that are still mentioned. Original recipes cannot be changed.

tools.name: scale_recipes
tools.description:
Show ingredient amounts for another number of servings: [{mealdb_id, servings}].

Needs known servings (set_recipe_servings). Nothing is saved; save_adapted_recipes stores a
scaled recipe as a variant if the user wants to keep it.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search TheMealDB for several recipe queries in one tool call.

tools.name: search_usda_foods
tools.description:
Search USDA FoodData Central for several terms and list candidates with fdc_id, description,
kcal, protein, fat and carbs per 100 g. Use it to choose a match by hand with set_ingredient_matches.

tools.name: set_ingredient_matches
tools.description:
Pin nutrition data to several ingredients and keep it, also with enrich_recipes refresh=true.

Either a USDA food: {ingredient, fdc_id, note}. Or, for foods USDA does not have, values per
100 g from a label: {ingredient, calories_per_100g, protein_per_100g, fat_per_100g,
carbs_per_100g, note}. Stored values count in get_nutrition and compare_nutrition.

tools.name: set_recipe_servings
tools.description:
Store how many servings recipes make: [{mealdb_id, servings}]. Variants inherit the value of
their original unless they have their own.

TheMealDB has no servings: use what the user says or what the instructions state, do not guess.
get_nutrition and compare_nutrition then also return per_serving.

tools.name: suggest_substitutions
tools.description:
Start the suggestion workflow for several ingredients.

Returns active substitutions, still pending suggestions and, for ingredients without either,
a structured suggestion_request (constraints, required tags, targets to avoid). Generate
candidates for that request and store them with record_substitution_suggestions.
Constraints example: {"diet": "vegan", "required_tags": ["nut free"], "excluded_ingredients": ["tofu"]}.

tools.name: update_recipe_variants
tools.description:
Edit several saved variants. Original recipes cannot be edited.

Each item needs mealdb_id and may set name, instructions, constraints and ingredients
(the complete new list [{position, name, measure}]). Changes to the original are recomputed.
